Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental factual error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the performer of the song "Lolita" as Leah LaBelle. The song "Lolita" is famously performed by Robyn (the Swedish singer), not Leah LaBelle. Because the Planner started with the wrong subject, all subsequent steps were wasted effort searching for the spouse of the wrong person, leading to the retrieval of incorrect information (Rasual Butler) for the specific question asked.
